nodes.name: ProgramCacheCreateOrderData.java
nodes.summary: Result holder for the create-order Lua cache operation, carrying the status code and the purchased seat list returned by Redis.

nodes.name: ProgramCacheCreateOrderData
nodes.summary: Simple data carrier mapping the Lua script's JSON response for order cache creation.

nodes.name: ProgramSeatCacheData.java
nodes.summary: Lua-backed Redis component that batch-loads seat data through a script and deserializes SeatVo lists, switching to parallel parsing above a size threshold.

nodes.name: ProgramSeatCacheData
nodes.summary: Spring component executing a Redis Lua script to fetch seat cache entries and deserializing them into SeatVo objects.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Loads the seat-fetch Lua script from the classpath into a DefaultRedisScript at startup.

nodes.name: getData
nodes.summary: Executes the Lua script with the given keys and deserializes the returned seat JSON strings, using parallel streams for large result sets.

nodes.name: BaseProgramOrder.java
nodes.summary: Base component providing the local-lock (ReentrantLock) guarded order creation helper shared by the V3 and V4 order strategies.

nodes.name: BaseProgramOrder
nodes.summary: Spring component wrapping order creation in per-ticket-category local locks obtained from LocalLockCache.

nodes.name: localLockCreateOrder
nodes.summary: Acquires ReentrantLocks for all involved ticket categories in sorted order, executes the lock task, and reliably releases the acquired locks.
nodes.languageNotes: Sorts lock keys before acquisition to guarantee a global lock ordering and avoid deadlocks.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderStrategy.java
nodes.summary: Strategy interface for versioned program order creation, declaring createOrder and version contracts.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderStrategy
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by the V1-V4 program order strategies and resolved by ProgramOrderContext.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV1Strategy.java
nodes.summary: V1 order strategy: runs the composite parameter check then creates the order directly, guarded by repeat-execute-limit and service-lock annotations.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV1Strategy
nodes.summary: Baseline V1 implementation of ProgramOrderStrategy delegating to ProgramOrderService.create.

nodes.name: createOrder
nodes.summary: Executes the composite order-create check and delegates to ProgramOrderService.create under idempotency and service-lock protection.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV2Strategy.java
nodes.summary: V2 order strategy combining local ReentrantLocks and distributed Redisson locks per ticket category before creating the order, with full lock release in finally blocks.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV2Strategy
nodes.summary: V2 implementation layering local locks and Redisson distributed locks around ProgramOrderService.create for strong concurrency control.

nodes.name: createOrder
nodes.summary: Acquires sorted local locks and distributed locks for all ticket categories, then creates the order, releasing every acquired lock in reverse nesting.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV3Strategy.java
nodes.summary: V3 order strategy using local locks plus the synchronous Redis cache-resolution order creation path (createNew).

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV3Strategy
nodes.summary: V3 implementation routing order creation through BaseProgramOrder.localLockCreateOrder and ProgramOrderService.createNew.

nodes.name: createOrder
nodes.summary: Runs the composite check and creates the order inside local locks using the synchronous cache-resolution flow.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV4Strategy.java
nodes.summary: V4 order strategy using local locks plus the asynchronous MQ-based order creation path (createNewAsync).

nodes.name: ProgramOrderV4Strategy
nodes.summary: V4 implementation routing order creation through BaseProgramOrder.localLockCreateOrder and ProgramOrderService.createNewAsync.

nodes.name: createOrder
nodes.summary: Runs the composite check and creates the order inside local locks using the asynchronous MQ flow.

nodes.name: SeatMatch.java
nodes.summary: Utility that finds adjacent seats for multi-ticket orders: same-row consecutive seats first, then same-column seats, with a random fallback.

nodes.name: SeatMatch
nodes.summary: Static helper class implementing adjacent-seat matching over available SeatVo lists.

nodes.name: findAdjacentSeatVos
nodes.summary: Selects the requested number of adjacent seats by trying same-row consecutive seats, then same-column seats, then a random subset; throws when insufficient.

nodes.name: findConsecutiveSeats
nodes.summary: Finds a run of consecutive column codes within one row of seats.

nodes.name: findSameColumnSeats
nodes.summary: Finds seats sharing the same column across consecutive rows.

nodes.name: FailureCallback.java
nodes.summary: Callback interface invoked when an MQ message send fails, receiving the throwable.

nodes.name: FailureCallback
nodes.summary: Functional callback interface with onFailure for failed message sends.

nodes.name: SuccessCallback.java
nodes.summary: Callback interface invoked on successful MQ message send, receiving the SendResult.

nodes.name: SuccessCallback
nodes.summary: Functional callback interface with onSuccess for confirmed message sends.

nodes.name: AbstractApplicationStartEventListenerHandler.java
nodes.summary: Base class for application-start event listener handlers, exposing a type identifier for ordering initialization components.

nodes.name: AbstractApplicationStartEventListenerHandler
nodes.summary: Abstract handler extended by startup initializers such as CompositeInit.

nodes.name: CompositeAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Spring auto-configuration registering the CompositeContainer and CompositeInit beans of the composite execution framework.

nodes.name: CompositeAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration class declaring compositeContainer and compositeInit beans.

nodes.name: CompositeContainer.java
nodes.summary: Container that collects all AbstractComposite beans at startup, groups them by type, builds tiered parent-ordered execution trees, and runs the matching tree on execute().

nodes.name: CompositeContainer
nodes.summary: Core of the composite pattern framework: builds and stores per-type execution trees of composite components.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: On application start, collects AbstractComposite beans, groups them by type and builds the execution tree for each.

nodes.name: buildTree
nodes.summary: Recursively attaches child components to their parent by executeParentOrder across execution tiers.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Groups components by execution tier and order, locates the root of the lowest tier and returns the assembled execution tree.

nodes.name: CompositeInit.java
nodes.summary: Application-start initializer that triggers CompositeContainer.init during service bootstrap.

nodes.name: CompositeInit
nodes.summary: Startup handler invoking composite container initialization at a defined execution order.
